# Draft:Sefayet Ullah Patwary

Sefayet Ullah Patwary was a Bangladeshi journalist and organiser.
Public activity
In May 2009, Patwary was quoted as the convener of the “Obhibhabok Shamannay Committee” at a press conference urging the government to cancel full implementation of the “structured question method” in Bangladesh’s SSC examinations.
